summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by 17 Education & Technology Group Inc. reporting its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The press release announces net revenues of RMB99.5M, gross margin of 61.9%, and a net loss of RMB19.4M. It highlights growth in the AI-powered application service Yiqi Aixue and a strong cash position of RMB352.4M. There are no terms of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event.
